source.title: [LAUNCH-001][P0] Qualify independent code reviewer and separate release approver
source.body:
# TYME-HALL-LAUNCH-001 — Independent Reviewer and Release Steward Qualification

**Priority:** P0 · **State:** OPEN / UNASSIGNED / NO ACCESS GRANTED · **Release target:** October 30, 2026 (conditional)  
**Governing command:** [Notion launch command](https://app.notion.com/p/3f5c51d54b758197a92ff59d2c203045) · [Launch dependency ledger #15](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-control-center/issues/15)  
**Authority posture:** human-governed. No issue, model or agent may grant GitHub merge/release privileges, production publication, payment, secrets, contributor identity, or Canon promotion.

## Why this gate is P0

Current [Hall ruleset #24880323](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/rules/24880323) is active and requires **one approving review**, last-push approval, stale approval dismissal, resolved conversations, and no bypass. Independent GitHub review is currently missing for:
- [Hall PR #19](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/pull/19) — Office freshness and premerge checks (draft).
- [Hall PR #20](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/pull/20) — controlled production release (draft; 38 offline test cases passed, not a live deploy).
- [Control Center PR #18](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-control-center/pull/18) — release packet/assurance evidence (draft).

**Production safety constraint:** Authenticated Cloudflare Pages `codex-interface` still has Git-triggered automatic **production** deploys enabled on `main`, while all preview deployments remain enabled. The production-only auto-build freeze must be **separately authorized and verified OFF BEFORE merging either Hall PR**; a code-only merge could otherwise publish without a separate founder release GO. Live Cloudflare settings, main, ruleset, secrets and GitHub environments are unchanged by this issue.

## Separated human responsibilities (do not collapse)

| Role | Mandate | Authority NOT conferred |
|---|---|---|
| A — independent code reviewer | Review exact PR head, changed files, denials, test evidence, supply chain, route preservation, licensing/privacy and rollback; return an independently attributable review | Not authorized to publish, modify Cloudflare, change GitHub rulesets, grant credentials, spend funds, approve Canon or sign founder GO |
| B — production release operator | When qualified and designated, manually start a release workflow against a specific independently reviewed `main` SHA | Cannot independently approve their own environment execution or expand release scope |
| C — founder / delegated separate human release approver | Record a distinct, explicit G6 GO and approve the protected deployment environment for an exact source SHA after all release gates pass | No hidden model/agent delegation; does not waive independent technical review |

Role B and role C **must be different human actors** when environment self-review prevention applies. Technical independence requires reviewer A not to be the author of the reviewed change. A public participant completing a cold-read/a11y test under [Hall issue #18](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/issues/18) is not thereby qualified to approve security-sensitive source code or obtain write access.

## Qualification protocol — evidence before access

- [ ] **Q1 — public-only screening:** Verify candidate controls the claimed GitHub identity. Request an uncoached review of these public artifacts, without credentials, private links, tokens or remote machine access. Record disclosure of affiliations/conflicts and scope availability.
- [ ] **Q2 — exercise technical judgment:** Require concrete file/line findings for at least one release-blocking case (e.g. production autobuild before merge; environment declaration without required reviewer; wrong/moved SHA; false route equivalence; supply-chain version pinning; bypass; credentials exposure) and a safe reproducible verification approach. Distinguish observed defects from speculation.
- [ ] **Q3 — understand governance:** Candidate must explicitly acknowledge GitHub review != founder G6, green CI != live Cloudflare deployment, test receipts != institutionally durable positive Phase 2, and new participants receive no implied identity/governance rights.
- [ ] **Q4 — identify least privilege:** Confirm GitHub's minimum permissions for an eligible required PR review under current repository rules and plan, separately from a mere commenter. Obtain explicit founder authorization **before** adding collaborator access. No Admin, Cloudflare, repo secrets, bypass actors, environment approver, or unattended automation credentials in initial reviewer assignment.
- [ ] **Q5 — source/head-specific review:** Obtain review of PR #19 and PR #20 against current head SHAs, explicit unresolved findings and one approving review only after defects have been addressed. Existing ruleset must never be bypassed. Review Control Center PR #18 independently if qualification extends to governance packet review.
- [ ] **Q6 — release operator vs founder:** Designate named human release operator and a separate founder-controlled environment reviewer; manually inspect actual `tymehall-production` required-reviewer settings, protected-main branch restriction, no-bypass/self-review posture, and protected environment-only secrets. **Do not rely on the YAML environment field alone**.
- [ ] **Q7 — staging/denial evidence:** Verify manual release source SHA equality, controlled asset route diff, missing-credential denial, unapproved environment denial, branch-race denial, isolated staging run, rollback and independent production readback. No live mutation before separate explicit authorization.
- [ ] **Q8 — documented acceptance:** Record actual reviewer GitHub login, scope of review, timestamp, exact PR commit SHAs, linked test evidence, outstanding findings, permissible permissions, independent founder authority, and GO/HOLD decision. If no qualified reviewer, retain intentional freeze.

## Public invitation posture

**Do not offer a paid bounty yet.** The related mobile cold-read contribution candidate is [UNFUNDED](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/issues/18). If recruiting volunteers, begin with a bounded public documentation/code-review exercise using only published material. No promised compensation, privilege, institutional authority or project endorsement. Screen attempts to redirect toward wallets, off-platform payment, unverifiable automated test claims or demands for credentials. Keep original issue #18's spam lock intact.

## Required independent evidence packet

```yaml
launch_id: TYME-HALL-LAUNCH-001
gate: G5_G6_REVIEWER_QUALIFICATION
reviewer_github_login: null
reviewer_role: unassigned
review_scope: public_only_screening
requested_access: none
granted_access: none
code_prs: [Codex-interface-#19, Codex-interface-#20, Codex-control-center#18]
observed_findings: []
reproduction_refs: []
head_sha_reviewed: null
actual_execution_time: null
human_approver: null
release_operator: null
environment_reviewer: founder_separate_actor_required
cloudflare_production_autodeploy: enabled
production_freeze_authorized: false
production_mutation_performed: false
bounty_status: unfunded
outcome: HOLD
authority_effect: none
next_valid_action: screen_uncoached_independent_reviewer
```

**Current gate:** `REVIEWER_UNASSIGNED / NO_GRANT / A9_OPEN / G5_OPEN / G6_HOLD`.  
**Dependencies:** [Controlled release runbook](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-interface-/blob/launch/001-controlled-production-release/validation/CONTROLLED_RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md) and [Control Center security ledger #17](https://github.com/sovereign-codex/Codex-control-center/issues/17).
